Hey guys! Has anyone had success with indoor gardening? I live in the North/Mid-west and would love to grow food, but I do not have a yard, nor do I have abundant sunlight in the winter. Any tips on where to start researching? Thanks!

Look into sprouting. I can tell you that you won't get much anything to grow indoors without a good bit of space and money for grow lights. Even if you have a south-facing window - most food plants need to be surrounded by the sun. A good aquaponics set up will not save you any money or even produce enough food to be worth investing in (on a small scale).

Sprouts and micro greens - unless you have a friend with a yard. Alternatively there are a lot of community gardens or you could volunteer on a local farm. There are plenty of ways to grow when you don't have any land.
